sections.heading: What the official record establishes
paragraphs: The Press Information Bureau record states that the Prime Minister expressed grief over the demise of Morbi’s Rajmata Vijaykunwarba. It also frames remembrance around her personality, spirit of service and close association with Morbi’s people.

The record records a condolence and prayers for the departed soul, family and admirers. It does not provide a biography, dates of public work, institutional position or details of any welfare intervention.

sections.heading: A constitutional reading
paragraphs: The title Rajmata carries social and historical meaning, but an honorific is not a constitutional office. In a UPSC answer, former royal association may be used to discuss social memory after political integration, provided it is not presented as continuing legal authority.

The practical lesson is to separate symbolic influence from accountable governance: public respect may encourage cooperation, whereas state action must remain grounded in law, equality and transparent institutions.
